_comment: Fortresses (online): the castles of the old kingdoms (the castles in data/settlements.json, listed under `fortresses` in server/world/world.json), held by their lords' garrisons. They work like robber baron camps with these numbers (the same keys as data/barons.json): every player has their own, starting at level 1, and every win (two from level 10) raises it a level, up to max_level, with a bigger garrison behind stronger walls and richer loot. A fortress beaten at level L rebuilds for rebuild_base + rebuild_per_level * (L - 1) seconds. It drops gear like a baron camp drop_level_bonus levels higher.
